title: Privacy policy
lead: Each Line app has its own policy, because each one reads something different. Pick a tool. The short version is the same for all five: no account, nothing sold, nothing sent to us.

headings.stores: What is saved on your computer

site: getlineapps.com loads no analytics until you accept them in the cookie banner. You can change your choice at any time from the link in the footer.
If you fill in the form after removing an extension, the reason and the text you write are emailed to me so I can improve the tool. Nothing else is attached, and it is not used for marketing.
changes: If this policy changes, the new version is posted here with a new date. A change that collects more data would also be described in the extension's release notes before it ships.
